definitions.explanation: Suspicion of having committed a crime. A legal and news term used to describe the grounds on which someone is arrested or investigated.

examples.japanese: {窃盗|せっとう}の{容疑|ようぎ}で{逮捕|たいほ}された。
examples.english: He was arrested on suspicion of theft.

examples.japanese: {容疑|ようぎ}を{否認|ひにん}している。
examples.english: The suspect is denying the charges.

examples.japanese: {詐欺|さぎ}の{容疑|ようぎ}で{指名手配|しめいてはい}されていた{男|おとこ}が、{空港|くうこう}で{身柄|みがら}を{確保|かくほ}された。
examples.english: A man who was wanted on suspicion of fraud was apprehended at the airport.

notes:
{容疑|ようぎ} combines {容|よう} (appearance, suspicion) and {疑|ぎ} (doubt, suspicion). It is a legal term frequently seen in news reports.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {容疑|ようぎ}で{逮捕|たいほ}される (to be arrested on suspicion of)
- {容疑|ようぎ}を{否認|ひにん}する (to deny the charges)
- {容疑|ようぎ}を{認|みと}める (to admit to the charges)
- {容疑|ようぎ}{者|しゃ} (suspect — a very common compound)
- {殺人|さつじん}の{容疑|ようぎ} (suspicion of murder)

USAGE:
The pattern 〜の{容疑|ようぎ}で (on suspicion of ~) is extremely common in crime reporting. {容疑|ようぎ}{者|しゃ} (suspect) is the standard term used in Japanese media for a person who has been arrested but not yet convicted.
